content.short: MyTonWallet is a fast self-custodial wallet for TON, TRON, and other supported assets.
content.description: MyTonWallet is a self-custodial wallet built with TON at the center. It supports sending, receiving, and managing Toncoin and other assets, while also expanding beyond TON for users who want a clean multichain wallet without giving up custody. Your fast, secure, and fully self-custodial crypto wallet for TON, TRON, and beyond. Explore smart swaps, native staking, NFTs, and more than 100 useful features - all in one place. Users see this through all-in-one wallet for ton, tron, and solana, cutting-edge security, features, and user reviews.
content.meta: MyTonWallet is a fast self-custodial wallet for TON, TRON, and other supported assets. Discover its TON role and related apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
